notes: Shared contract (voice iteration 0.2): words that mean 'I need help'. Checked BEFORE the model on every channel (app, WhatsApp, calls): SOS never depends on the model.
Every language is checked whatever the member's language (people switch languages under stress).
Latin-script phrases match whole words; other scripts match anywhere (Tamil words take endings).
Deliberately broad: 'help me find a walk' also matches (iteration 0.2 T3). The SOS screen's 5-second countdown with Cancel makes a false alarm cheap; a missed one is not.
ms / zh / ta still need a native speaker's review (voice 1.1-1.2). The app's Buddy keeps the same words (app test: distress-sync).
